  "guitar-play": "From the open third string, slide up to the fifth fret to play a perfect fourth interval. Voila, let the two notes blend like old friends, Over.",
  "workbook-be": "In your journal, describe a scene where the fifth fret is a doorway to a hidden garden. Alors, write what you see, hear, and feel as you step through, Over.",
  "workbook-do": "Recall the hum you sang earlier and note how the pitch felt in your throat. Ecoute, describe any shifts in color or emotion that arose as you listened, Over.",
  "workbook-play": "Set up your recorder and play the fifth‑fret B note three times, listening for even tone. Voila, press play and celebrate the sound you created, Over.",
  "workbook-reflection": "Take a moment to release any critique of your performance, letting the music flow like a river. Bravo, embrace the silence after the last note, knowing each attempt is a step forward, Over."
